description: This file defines the SystemCheckController class within the OrangeHRM installer upgrader namespace. The class extends an abstract controller and primarily sets up a component and updates the state container during pre-rendering.

classes.name: SystemCheckController
classes.description: Controller for the system check step in the OrangeHRM installer upgrader process, responsible for setting up the system check component during rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook method that initializes the system check component and updates the current screen state.
